references.notes: Replaces old ref 2 (Pfizer paxlovidhcp.com interactions page, mislabelled as full prescribing information). DailyMed page text was read in sections because WebFetch truncated at 100,000 characters; section 14 (Clinical Studies) and section 12.4 (Microbiology) were not readable, so efficacy figures come from EPIC-HR on PubMed and no in-vitro variant data are cited. No rosuvastatin entry was found in the readable Table 2 text, so the rosuvastatin advice was cut. Hypertension appears as an EUA/postmarketing listing; the guide says "reported since authorization", hence partly_supported. Quotes joined with "..." are contiguous label fragments returned by WebFetch.
